options: What does freedom means to you?
What do freedom mean to you?
What does freedom mean to you?

options: What a proud day it is!
What a proud day it are!

An imperative gives a request: Please + base verb ...

chat: When do we celebrate Independence Day?
questions.rule: We takes the base verb in the simple present: We celebrate.

chat: Someone threw a paper flag on the road.
options: We should picks it up and keep it safe.
We should picked it up and keep it safe.
We should pick it up and keep it safe.
questions.rule: After should use the base verb: should pick.

options: How beautiful does the flag look!

What a + adjective + noun + subject + verb!

options: What a wonderful news it is?

options: I like mangoes. They is sweet and juicy.
I likes mangoes. They are sweet and juicy.
I like mangoes. They are sweet and juicy.
questions.rule: I like (no -s with I) and They are (plural).

questions.prompt: Which is a correctly written statement?
questions.rule: A declarative sentence (statement) has a full verb and ends with a full stop.

options: Each of the children have a flag.
Each of the child has a flag.
Each of the children has a flag.
questions.rule: Each of the + plural noun takes a singular verb: Each of the children has.

options: We need to keep our nation clean.

We need keep our nation clean.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.

The subject is One, which is singular: One of my friends is.

questions.after: get equal chances to play sports.

Singular subject Our teacher + verb with -es: teaches.

chat: Grandpa cannot reach the voting booth on his own.
options: We can take him there on our scooter.
We can takes him there on our scooter.
We can taking him there on our scooter.

options: Everybody need an equal chance to learn.

options: Did you watched the parade on television?

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.

Adverb never comes after the modal and before the main verb: must never waste.
Past question: Wh- word + did + subject + base verb ... ?

Yes, he plays cricket and swim every day.

What a brilliant team you is!

Each of the eight children share an idea for a better and fairer India.
Each of the eight child shares an idea for a better and fairer India.

We should vote because good leaders works for everyone's future.
